about: Inventory for the experiments tracker artifact; built from the repo and chat history.

items.title: Guide: Wang Bi
items.what: A Hitchhiker's Guide-style short: a book-device entry on Wang Bi, read by a dry narrator, in the 1981 BBC neon-outline look.
items.next: Wait for the user's verdict on the full cut.
items.userSaid: I think the guide shorts are a real format. Um, but yeah, maybe we need a few more smoke tests to refine it.

On the retro smoke test: 'can we use I-Ching instead of I Ching. and it looks good.'
Draft 2 is Astra's revision.

items.title: Neon character drawings
items.what: Neon Blender drawings of 21 hexagram characters, each acting out its meaning (困, 益, 蠱, 井, 屯, 明, 鼎, 解, 恆, 需, 臨, 艮, 剝, 旅, 兌, 比, 同, 既, 復, 履, 頤).
items.userSaid: Keep going. Love this series so far
notes: First try (困 drawn plain) was rejected: 'The characters look like they were drawn by a child.' Redone as neon tubes.
Also sent: 困 alone, 9 s silent (out/characters/47-kun-character.mp4).

Characters: 困 hardship, 益 increase, 蠱 decay, 井 well, 屯 sprouting, 明 bright, 鼎 cauldron, 解 release, 恆 constancy, 需 waiting, 臨 approach, 艮 stillness, 剝 stripping, 旅 travel, 兌 joy, 比 together, 同 same, 既 already, 復 return, 履 tread, 頤 jaws.
